doc.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024

title: Jay McShann mistaken for Bobby Blue Bland
summary: At lunch in Kansas City a woman insists Jay McShann is Bobby Bland, and he signs the autograph.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: a younger woman, comes over to Jay and she says, “I know you. My mom has all your records. I know you, you’re famous.” And Jay, you know, you know Jay, Jay was real humble and you know Jay’s like, “Oh well.” “Yeah, yeah, I know who you are. My mom has all your records. I grew up listening to you.” And Jay’s like, “Oh.” She goes, “You’re Bobby Blue Bland.” And so Jay starts trying to convince her that he’s not. And I’m just sitting there cracking up you know. And Jay’s like, “No, no, my name’s Jay.” And she’s like, “No, I know who you are, you’re Bobby Bland.” He goes, “No, my name’s Hootie. I’m Hootie.” She goes, “No, I know who you are. You’re Bobby Blue Bland. My mom has all your records.” And this goes on for — I’m just cracking up. Jay keeps telling her he’s Jay McShann and she keeps insisting he’s Bobby Bland. So then she whips — she goes, “I’ve got to get your autograph for my mom.” And she whipped something out of her purse, sticks it in front of Jay. So I’m watching Jay to see what he’s going to do. Sure enough, he signs it Bobby Blue Bland and gives it back to her.
Oh that’s great. Thank you for that.
